core.title: Commercial Compliant Full Cover Surface Mount Closer, Yale 2701

text.description_html:
Yale 2701 Full Cover Closer

The Yale 2700 Series features full rack and pinion construction, heavy duty cast aluminum closer body, stamped flat style arm assembly and full architectural cover. The Yale 2701 Door Closer features rugged construction as well as adjustments for backcheck, closing, and latch speed.

Yale 2701 Series door closers are non-handed, and tri-packed for regular, top jamb and parallel arm applications.

Specifications and Features for the Yale 2701 Commercial Door Closer:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Cast Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Non-Handed
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 12"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Spring Size: 1-6
  • ADA Compliant Door Hardware
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting.
  • Yale 2701 Installation Instructions

Sold Individually
